segments.name: Secured Logistics Business
segments.description: Provides traditional secured logistics and cash management services, mainly to banks and retail customers in Thailand.
segments.evidence: The Legacy Secured Logistics business metric includes revenues from (i) Cash-In-Transit – Non-Dedicated Vehicle (Non-DV); (ii) Cash-In-Transit – Dedicated Vehicle (DV); (iii) ATM management; (iv) Cash Processing (CPC); (v) Cash Center Operations (CCT); (vi) Consolidate Cash Center Operations (CCC); and (vii) Others.

segments.name: Corporate and others
segments.description: Covers non-operating activities including holdings, treasury organization, headquarters and central functions.
segments.evidence: The Corporate and others segment covers the non-operating activities supporting the Company.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay service fees for cash logistics, lease or subscription payments for robots and AI solutions, advertising screen leases, and one-time installation plus recurring monthly fees for smart retail solutions.
revenueModel.evidence: For our Smart Retail Solution, we typically charge a one-time installation fee, followed by recurring monthly fees for services, maintenance, and software management.

changes.text: In 2024, the company completed the separation with its Handshake information security business, presented as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: we have completed the separation with Handshake on February 6, 2024.

changes.text: In 2025, the company agreed to dispose of Beijing Wanjia, with the equity transfer completed in January 2026 and operations classified as discontinued.
changes.evidence: On December 25, 2025, we entered into an equity transfer agreement to dispose of our entire equity interest in Beijing Wanjia and the equity transfer was completed on January 9, 2026.
